title: MITRA-Swarm: Injecting Explicit Linguistic Structure into Foundation Models for Classical Machine Translation
abstract: arXiv:2611.14675v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Classical Sanskrit poses three challenges unresolved by single-call monolithic models: morphophonemic fusion Sandhi, dense nominal compounding Sam\=asa, and discourse-level zero-anaphora forced by poetic meter. We present MITRA-Swarm, a multi-agent architecture injecting explicit linguistic structure into an otherwise monolithic pipeline: a Sandhi-splitting agent, a parallel array of generalist gemma-4-26B-A4B-it and domain-specialized gemma-2-mitra-it translators, and a discourse-aware Ellipsis Restorer that consults corpus-derived register tags to avoid inventing active-voice subjects in impersonal legal and philosophical registers. Two separated judges evaluate quality: a routing judge ($J_{\text{route}}$, same model family as the generators) driving an internal critique loop, and an independent reporting judge ($J_{\text{report}}=$gpt-4o-mini, no shared vendor lineage) scoring every output exactly once. translated_title: MITRA-Swarm：将显式语言结构注入基础模型以实现古典语言机器翻译
translated_abstract: 古典梵语给单次调用的单体模型带来了三个尚未解决的挑战：形态音位融合（连声 Sandhi）、密集的名词复合（复合词 Samāsa），以及由诗歌韵律强制产生的语篇层面零回指。我们提出了 MITRA-Swarm，这是一种多智能体架构，将显式语言结构注入到原本单一化的流水线中：包括一个连声拆分智能体、一个由通用型 gemma-4-26B-A4B-it 和领域专精型 gemma-2-mitra-it 翻译器组成的并行阵列，以及一个语篇感知的省略恢复器，该恢复器参考语料库派生的语域标签，以避免在非人称的法律和哲学语域中虚构主动语态主语。两个相互分离的评审器负责评估质量：一个路由评审器（J_route，与生成器属于同一模型家族）驱动内部批评循环，以及一个独立的报告评审器（J_report = gpt-4o-mini，无共同供应商谱系）对每个输出仅评分一次。在一个分层基准上……
tldr: MITRA-Swarm 通过多智能体架构将显式语言学结构（连声拆分、专用翻译器阵列、语域感知的省略恢复）注入基础模型流水线，并辅以双独立评审机制，从而攻克古典梵语机器翻译中的三大核心难题。
en_tdlr: MITRA-Swarm injects explicit linguistic structure into foundation-model pipelines via a multi-agent architecture—combining Sandhi splitting, specialized translator arrays, and register-aware ellipsis restoration—paired with dual independent judges to tackle the three core challenges of classical Sanskrit machine translation.
